name: query
description: Graph query and context assembly. Enables structured queries, path finding, impact simulation, and LLM context building.
intent: Graph query and context assembly. Enables structured queries, path finding, impact simulation, and LLM context building.

components.name: query_engine
components.description: Graph query language. Supports callees(), callers(), depends(), explain().

components.name: path_query
components.description: Path finding between nodes. BFS shortest path and all-paths enumeration.

components.name: context_builder
components.description: Assembles rich context for LLM consumption. Gathers node, callers, callees, intent.

components.name: simulator
components.description: Impact simulation. Predicts blast radius of changes to a node.

rules.reason: Query subsystem reads graphs. It should not depend on governance.
